full_name: Rana Dajani | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Medicine Rita E. Hauser Fellow Hashemite University (Jordan)
bio: At Radcliffe, Rana Dajani is writing a book that documents—from the perspective of a female, Muslim, Arab scientist who has worked in various cultures—the challenges that women face in academia; how that varies across cultures, religions, and disciplines; and how women have dealt with these challenges in different ways. She will highlight how women’s experiences have shaped their meanings of success.
